purpose: Compare the evidence-selected LaunchDistro cross-distro source reduction with its terminal minimal-v6 diagnostic parent under the unchanged K-OVERLAY-PIDNS-001 kernel, diagnostic instrumentation, fixed Toybox probe, and stock recovery contract.

classification.basis: The candidate mounted the registered ext4 filesystem read-write and entered LaunchInit. The prior excluded cross-distro mount failure disappeared, but WslCorePort still closed before CreateInstanceResult.

candidate.experimentalDelta: remove only the unconditional LaunchDistro CROSS_DISTRO_SHARE_PATH temporary-mount and associated read-only fallback block

candidateInterval.failureSignature: The prior cross-distro ENOENT and temporary-overlay fallback disappeared; WslCorePort still closed after LaunchInit without CreateInstanceResult, followed only by a secondary ErrorExit cleanup read failure for /proc/self/task/1/children

comparison.parentResult: B3 with repeated excluded CROSS_DISTRO_SHARE_PATH ENOENT after successful temporary-overlay construction
comparison.candidateResult: B3 without the cross-distro or temporary-overlay signature; channel closure remains before CreateInstanceResult
comparison.decision: The source reduction removed its selected failure but did not establish B4. The later /proc/self/task/1/children error belongs to ErrorExit cleanup and does not select a Kconfig facility.

decision: Finalize this evidence-selected comparison at B3 without rerun. Preserve the changed failure signature, retain K-OVERLAY-PIDNS-001 and existing instrumentation, and inspect the retained distro-init startup path before selecting one further source diagnostic or reduction. Do not add CONFIG_PROC_CHILDREN from the secondary cleanup error.
